item.tib: khro bo smad 'grel rgyud gsang ba don 'grel smad kyi 'grel ba 'phrul gyi lde mig
item.coloph: smad 'grel rin chen dmigs bsal gyi sgron ma 'di/ bla chen sprul pa rma ston gyis/ sham po'i dpal nas 'gro ba'i don du gdan drangs nas/ 'gro ba'i don du rgya cher spel/ bla ma khong la/ rma ston shes rab seng 'ges bstan pa/ bru ston bdag gis zhus so/ gter shog bu la dbang bar bris/ 'di bris dge rtsa dri med des/ myur du bla med 'bras bu thob par shog 'gru ston rin chen blo gros mnyes pa'i don ched du/ a 'ag+hon bdag gis bris pa lags//
